The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with Complaint Case No. 1384(C)/2019 dated 21.10.2019 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 323, 341, 504, 498A and 494/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The petitioner and the complainant are husband and wife and it has been jointly prayed by the parties that they want to reconcile their matrimonial relationship, therefore, the matter may be sent to the mediation centre.

4. Let the matter be referred to the Patna High Court Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.18475 of 2023(2) dt.12-06-2023 Mediation Centre for reconciliation between the parties.
5.
